info.text:
Berkshire Hathaway just reported buying back $9.6 billion of its own stock (July-September).
That's more than double the $4.5 billion it spent in Q2 (Q3 2026 report, Nov 7).
Operating profit fell 5.8% to $12.7 billion; Geico's underwriting profit fell to $982 million from $1.77 billion.
Cash pile: $377.4 billion at the end of September.
Sources: Berkshire Hathaway Q3 2026 report, AP, CNBC, Bloomberg.
News and education, not financial advice.
